# Toolbox

> Fast, private developer tools that run entirely in your browser. 129 tools, no sign up, no uploads.

Everything runs as JavaScript in your own browser, so your input never reaches a server.

Pages describe what they can do through WebMCP (navigator.modelContext), so an assistant reading a tool can call it rather than drive the interface. 7 tools across 5 pages do this so far, marked below.

Languages: English (https://jsglobe.com/), Deutsch (https://jsglobe.com/de/), Español (https://jsglobe.com/es/), 中文 (https://jsglobe.com/zh/), Français (https://jsglobe.com/fr/), Português (https://jsglobe.com/pt/), 日本語 (https://jsglobe.com/ja/), 한국어 (https://jsglobe.com/ko/), Nederlands (https://jsglobe.com/nl/), Svenska (https://jsglobe.com/sv/), Norsk (https://jsglobe.com/no/), Dansk (https://jsglobe.com/da/), Polski (https://jsglobe.com/pl/), Українська (https://jsglobe.com/uk/)

## Crypto & Security

- [Hash Text](https://jsglobe.com/apps/hash-text): MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 digests
- [HMAC](https://jsglobe.com/apps/hmac-generator): Keyed hash message authentication codes
- [Encrypt / Decrypt](https://jsglobe.com/apps/encryption): AES-GCM text encryption with a passphrase
- [Token Generator](https://jsglobe.com/apps/token-generator): Strong random passwords and API tokens
- [TOTP](https://jsglobe.com/apps/otp-generator): Time based one-time passwords from a secret
- [Basic Auth](https://jsglobe.com/apps/basic-auth): Build Authorization headers from credentials
- [Key Pair](https://jsglobe.com/apps/rsa-keygen): Generate RSA and elliptic curve keys as PEM
- [Password Strength](https://jsglobe.com/apps/password-strength): Entropy, weaknesses and time to crack
- [Certificate Decoder](https://jsglobe.com/apps/cert-decoder): Read an X.509 certificate or signing request
- [SSH Keys](https://jsglobe.com/apps/ssh-keys): Generate and inspect OpenSSH keys offline

## Converters

- [Base64](https://jsglobe.com/apps/base64-converter): Encode and decode text or files [tools: encode_base64, decode_base64]
- [Color Converter](https://jsglobe.com/apps/color-converter): HEX, RGB, HSL, OKLCH and contrast checks
- [Colour Palette](https://jsglobe.com/apps/color-palette): Tailwind style scales, a colour wheel and harmonies
- [Case Converter](https://jsglobe.com/apps/case-converter): camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case and more [tools: convert_case]
- [Date & Time](https://jsglobe.com/apps/date-converter): Unix timestamps, ISO 8601 and relative time
- [Number Base](https://jsglobe.com/apps/base-converter): Binary, octal, decimal, hex and any base
- [JSON ⇄ YAML](https://jsglobe.com/apps/json-yaml): Convert between JSON and YAML documents
- [Text Encoder](https://jsglobe.com/apps/text-encoder): Binary, hex, unicode, NATO, morse and ROT13
- [List Converter](https://jsglobe.com/apps/list-converter): Sort, dedupe, wrap and rejoin lists
- [Roman Numerals](https://jsglobe.com/apps/roman-numerals): Convert numbers to and from Roman numerals
- [Currency](https://jsglobe.com/apps/currency-converter): Convert between currencies with daily rates
- [Morse Code](https://jsglobe.com/apps/morse-code): Translate text to Morse and play it back
- [PDF Studio](https://jsglobe.com/apps/pdf-studio): Merge, split, rotate and convert PDFs

## Web

- [URL Encode](https://jsglobe.com/apps/url-encoder): Percent-encode and decode URL components
- [URL Parser](https://jsglobe.com/apps/url-parser): Break a URL into its parts and query params
- [HTML Entities](https://jsglobe.com/apps/html-entities): Escape and unescape HTML entities
- [JWT Parser](https://jsglobe.com/apps/jwt-parser): Decode and inspect JSON Web Tokens
- [Keycode Info](https://jsglobe.com/apps/keycode-info): Inspect keyboard events key by key
- [Slugify](https://jsglobe.com/apps/slugify): Turn any string into a clean URL slug [tools: slugify_text]
- [HTTP Status](https://jsglobe.com/apps/http-status): Searchable reference of HTTP status codes
- [Header Review](https://jsglobe.com/apps/http-headers): Grade response headers for security and privacy
- [Gradient Maker](https://jsglobe.com/apps/css-gradient): Build CSS gradients with draggable colour stops
- [CSS Animation](https://jsglobe.com/apps/css-animation): Keyframe presets with a cubic-bezier editor

## Development

- [JSON Formatter](https://jsglobe.com/apps/json-formatter): Format, validate, minify and explore JSON [tools: format_json, check_json]
- [JSON Diff](https://jsglobe.com/apps/json-diff): Compare two JSON documents key by key
- [SQL Formatter](https://jsglobe.com/apps/sql-formatter): Readable formatting for SQL statements
- [XML Formatter](https://jsglobe.com/apps/xml-formatter): Indent and minify XML or HTML markup
- [Crontab](https://jsglobe.com/apps/crontab-generator): Explain cron expressions and preview next runs
- [Chmod](https://jsglobe.com/apps/chmod-calculator): Unix permissions in octal and symbolic form
- [Regex Tester](https://jsglobe.com/apps/regex-tester): Test patterns with live matches and groups
- [CSV Studio](https://jsglobe.com/apps/csv-studio): Open, edit and convert CSV data in a table
- [Mock Data](https://jsglobe.com/apps/mock-data): Generate realistic test data from a field list
- [JSON Schema](https://jsglobe.com/apps/json-schema): Infer a schema from samples and validate documents
- [API Spec Editor](https://jsglobe.com/apps/api-spec): Edit and check OpenAPI documents
- [Docker Compose](https://jsglobe.com/apps/docker-compose): Convert docker run commands to compose files
- [Compose to K8s](https://jsglobe.com/apps/compose-to-k8s): Turn a compose file into Kubernetes manifests
- [Kubernetes](https://jsglobe.com/apps/kubernetes): Generate deployment, service and ingress manifests
- [JSX to SVG](https://jsglobe.com/apps/jsx-svg): Convert React components to SVG and back
- [GitIgnore Generator](https://jsglobe.com/apps/gitignore-generator): Build a .gitignore from the tools you use

## Network

- [Subnet Calculator](https://jsglobe.com/apps/subnet-calculator): IPv4 CIDR ranges, masks and host counts
- [IP Converter](https://jsglobe.com/apps/ip-converter): IPv4 in decimal, hex, binary and octal
- [MAC Address](https://jsglobe.com/apps/mac-generator): Generate and reformat MAC addresses
- [DNS Lookup](https://jsglobe.com/apps/dns-lookup): Dig style record lookups over DNS-over-HTTPS
- [Speed Test](https://jsglobe.com/apps/speed-test): Measure download, upload, latency and jitter
- [Domain Lookup](https://jsglobe.com/apps/rdap-lookup): RDAP records for a domain, IP or network
- [WebSocket Tester](https://jsglobe.com/apps/websocket-tester): Connect to a socket and watch the frames

## Text

- [Lorem Ipsum](https://jsglobe.com/apps/lorem-ipsum): Placeholder copy in words, sentences or lists
- [Text Stats](https://jsglobe.com/apps/text-stats): Counts, reading time and character analysis
- [Text Diff](https://jsglobe.com/apps/text-diff): Compare two texts line by line
- [Markdown](https://jsglobe.com/apps/markdown-preview): Write markdown and preview the HTML
- [Emoji Picker](https://jsglobe.com/apps/emoji-picker): Browse, search and copy emoji with their code points
- [Unicode Tables](https://jsglobe.com/apps/unicode-tables): Browse Unicode blocks and inspect any character
- [Documents Studio](https://jsglobe.com/apps/doc-editor): Write, format and export documents as PDF or Word, entirely in your browser
- [Letters](https://jsglobe.com/apps/letters): Learn the Greek, Cyrillic, Japanese, Korean and Chinese letters

## Math & Units

- [Math Evaluator](https://jsglobe.com/apps/math-evaluator): Evaluate expressions with functions and constants [tools: evaluate_expression]
- [Unit Converter](https://jsglobe.com/apps/unit-converter): Length, mass, data, temperature and time
- [Function Plotter](https://jsglobe.com/apps/function-plotter): Graph expressions with zoom, roots and derivatives
- [Statistics](https://jsglobe.com/apps/statistics): Summary, histogram and box plot for a set of numbers

- [Icon Studio](https://jsglobe.com/apps/icon-studio): Build an icon from thousands of parts, or describe one

- [Placeholder SVG](https://jsglobe.com/apps/svg-placeholder): Generate placeholder images as inline SVG
- [ASCII Art](https://jsglobe.com/apps/ascii-art): Text banners and image to ASCII conversion
- [SVG Studio](https://jsglobe.com/apps/svg-editor): View, clean, recolour and export SVG
- [Voice Recorder](https://jsglobe.com/apps/voice-recorder): Record audio and transcribe it on this device
- [Mirror](https://jsglobe.com/apps/mirror): Camera mirror with an adjustable ring light
- [Screenshot Studio](https://jsglobe.com/apps/screenshot): Capture, annotate, blur and compare screenshots
- [Paint](https://jsglobe.com/apps/paint): Pencil, shapes, fill and spray on a canvas
- [Poster Studio](https://jsglobe.com/apps/poster-studio): Design posters and social variants with an event QR

## Utility

- [UUID](https://jsglobe.com/apps/uuid-generator): Generate v4 and v7 identifiers in bulk
- [Device Info](https://jsglobe.com/apps/device-info): Everything the browser knows about this device
- [Clock](https://jsglobe.com/apps/clock): World clocks, stopwatch and countdown timer
- [Calendar](https://jsglobe.com/apps/calendar): Month view with events saved per workspace
- [Portfolio](https://jsglobe.com/apps/portfolio): Track holdings, allocation and profit or loss
- [Notes](https://jsglobe.com/apps/notes): Quick scratch notes saved to this workspace
- [Tasks](https://jsglobe.com/apps/todo): A lightweight checklist per workspace
- [Time Zones](https://jsglobe.com/apps/timezone-planner): Line up cities and find the overlapping hours
- [IBAN Validator](https://jsglobe.com/apps/iban-validator): Check bank account numbers and read their parts
- [Serial Console](https://jsglobe.com/apps/serial-console): Talk to a serial device over USB
- [Bluetooth](https://jsglobe.com/apps/bluetooth-scanner): Read, subscribe and write to GATT characteristics
- [Gamepad Tester](https://jsglobe.com/apps/gamepad-tester): Check every stick, trigger and button
- [Code Scanner](https://jsglobe.com/apps/scanner): Read QR codes and bar codes from the camera, a picture or the screen
- [Tax Calculator](https://jsglobe.com/apps/tax-calculator): Work out net pay after tax in 23 countries, entirely on your device
